overviewMarkdown:
# PR #56: Make payment retries safer during provider brownouts [DEMO]

> **Synthetic demo data.** This PR, its identities, links, comments, and publication results are local examples. Nothing in this scenario contacts or writes to GitHub.

- **Author:** `@demo-alex` (synthetic identity)
- **State:** Open — demo fixture
- **Base:** `main` (`aaaaaaaaaaaa`)
- **Head:** `demo/retry-budget` (`bbbbbbbbbbbb`)
- **Demo link:** [Synthetic PR — local demo link only](#demo-pr-link)
- **Changed files:** 4 across `src/`, `docs/`, and `assets/`

## Description

This private-first review adds bounded full-jitter retries for card charges. The implementation keeps the retry window under 30 seconds, reserves provider capacity for first attempts, adds deterministic tests, renames the operator runbook, and includes one binary change that cannot receive inline comments.

## Existing discussion

### Issue comment — `@demo-riley` — synthetic target `issue-comment:900001`

Please keep the rollout reversible. Support needs one switch that stops new retries without interrupting successful first attempts.

[Demo link — issue comment](#demo-issue-comment-900001)

### Review summary — `@demo-morgan` — synthetic review `900002`

The direction looks good. I want explicit coverage for the total deadline and a clear capacity budget before approval.

[Demo link — review summary](#demo-review-summary-900002)

### Inline review thread — `@demo-sam` — synthetic root `900003`

Can this sleep push the charge beyond the provider timeout? Please tie it to the overall retry deadline.

#### Reply — `@demo-alex`

Good catch. The new `remainingMs` clamp keeps each sleep inside the 30-second window.

[Demo link — inline thread](#demo-review-thread-900003)
